finalText:
380 commits, ~130 PR. 90%+ dep bumps/refactor/CI/test noise, ignored. Real signal: 1 breaking, 1 feat, 10 fix, all pulled from `fix()`/`feat()` commits cross-checked against `code` label in merged-prs.tsv.

**4.2.0** written into CHANGELOG.md:

- **Breaking:** expired token now `401` not `403` — flag for anyone special-casing status codes.
- **Added:** webhook retry with exponential backoff.
- **Fixed:** null-cursor pagination crash (hit queue/api/webhooks/db separately, one fix per module), duplicate response headers (core/billing/http), double-trim trailing slash (queue/jobs), empty-allowlist mishandling (store/db/jobs), HTTP timer leak on socket drop, pool not closed on shutdown, full request body logged (privacy), trace ID dropped on retry, wrong histogram units, vague token-parser errors.

Note: same fix title landed 3x in same module (`fix(api): keep the trace id across the retry` — 05-22, 06-01, 06-13; `fix(core): drop the duplicate header` — 05-09, 06-06, 06-16). Different files each time, so treated as real distinct fixes, collapsed to one bullet each. Worth a sanity check with whoever owns api/core before ship — repeated title pattern could mean the bug kept regressing.
